message.content:
A classic lasagna typically includes:

| Category | Typical Ingredients |
|----------|---------------------|
| **Lasagna sheets** | Fresh or dried pasta sheets (or no-boil sheets) |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef or Italian sausage, onion, garlic, crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce, tomato paste, oregano, basil, salt, pepper, red‑pepper flakes (optional), olive oil |
| **Bechamel (white sauce)** | Butter, all‑purpose flour, milk, nutmeg, salt, pepper |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese, egg, grated Parmesan, chopped parsley or basil, salt, pepper |
| **Mozzarella** | Shredded mozzarella (or sliced) |
| **Parmesan** | Grated Parmesan for topping |
| **Optional extras** | Spinach, mushrooms, zucchini, bell pepper, olives, capers, or a splash of white wine in the meat sauce |

**Basic assembly**: Layer cooked lasagna sheets with meat sauce, béchamel, ricotta mixture, and mozzarella; repeat until the pan is filled, finishing with a generous layer of mozzarella and Parmesan on top. Bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for about 45–55 minutes, or until bubbly and golden. Enjoy!
